production_contract: Unchanged Rust finished_meeting_export/replay, raw parser and candidate decoder
items: Exact kind, commitment state, quote, source bytes/fingerprint, supported owner and verbatim due phrase. Unsupported details stay null. Raw production candidates are scored even when calibration would abstain.
calibration: Calibration-only raw distributions; exact production prompt, ordered labels, grouping, model/provider/revision/artifact and resource context. Freeze fitted artifact before exporting held-out requests.
resource_scope: Owned application client plus owned model process for local; owned application client for hosted, with remote server CPU/RSS explicitly unavailable. Fixed five cold-client and thirty warm complete production jobs; repeated timing adds no quality credit.
adoption: Emit reviewable candidate records only after every exact-context gate passes. This runner never writes the application registry or changes admission. Synthetic qualification is not natural-ASR, human or live/background acceptance.
